title: Poem - Sacrifice
content:
I said I'd die for her.

But the truth hangs heavy.


I could not live for her.

Could not bend my own shadows,

Could not lift the weight of myself.


Just to fit her light —

What use is dying,

When living was the harder vow?

What use is sacrifice,

If I remain a stranger to myself?


So I stand with the words unspoken,

A graveyard of promises

I could never keep —

Not for her,

Not for me.


Yet in some untold tomorrow,

I wonder if she’ll know —

That even in my failing,

My ruin was love.
